urgente_mesaje:
[19:20] Oaspete (Maria Corrnelia Calota): Buna seara! 
Ajungem in 40 de minute ls locatie.

Oare s a rezolvat cu apa? 

Maine ar fi posibil sa plecam putin mai tarziu? Aprox 12?
 Mesaj tradus: Good evening! 
We'll be at the property in 40 minutes.

Has the water issue been resolved? 

Would it be possible to leave a little later tomorrow? Around 12?

[23:04] Oaspete (Maria Corrnelia Calota): Multumesc!

Apa merge.
Un singur detaliu: prizele de la pat stanga dreapta nu merg, si noi o vom folosi pe cea de sub televizor.

The water is working.
Just one thing: The electrical outlets on both sides of the bed don't work, so we'll be using the one below the TV.
